visual.eye_path: Headline -> upper-left opportunity -> upper-right advantage -> central North Star -> lower-left plan -> lower-right measure -> maturity/value close -> footer.
visual.imagery: Small outline icons mark each strategic area, while the central target icon and circle carry the main visual metaphor.
visual.typography: Heavy navy all-caps title; dark coloured quadrant headings; bold subheads; compact bullet lists and numbered phases. Yellow hand-drawn underline is a minor attention accent.
visual.layout: A precise four-quadrant board around a centre circle; each quadrant uses a lightly tinted rounded rectangle and holds a different mix of prompts, lists, and metrics.
visual.pacing: Headline and four-zone structure are immediate; readers then browse a quadrant based on their current question; centre circle acts as a return anchor.
visual.technical_treatment: White paper, navy ink, pale red/blue/yellow/green panels, black rounded outlines, simple coloured line icons, and a yellow marker underline.
visual.visual_mechanism: The central north-star circle turns four potentially disconnected strategy workstreams into parts of one stated purpose and success definition.
visual.craft_notes: The central circle is a strong organising device; quadrant names represent distinct jobs rather than mere decoration; content is dense and some language is generic, while the 90-day and value claims need independent evidence and cannot be treated as a deployment template.

attention_physics.thumbnail_read_0_3_seconds: PROCUREMENT AI STRATEGY MAP and the large four-colour quadrant board establish a strategic planning promise.
attention_physics.comprehension_3_10_seconds: The reader sees four differently named strategic zones bound by one central North Star circle.
attention_physics.value_exchange_10_30_seconds: Each quadrant offers a different discussion task: diagnose opportunity, identify use cases, operationalise work, or measure outcome.
attention_physics.identity_or_curiosity_trigger: Have we jumped to tools before agreeing why and how value should be measured?
attention_physics.promise_proved_by_visual: The central circle visibly connects the four planning dimensions; it does not prove a 90-day transformation or the listed AI outcomes.

visual_anatomy.dominant_anchor: central Our North Star circle over four quadrants
visual_anatomy.colour_material: white ground, navy ink, pale red/blue/yellow/green quadrants, yellow underline
visual_anatomy.density: high; quadrant choice enables selective reading

recombination.primary_cognitive_job: Hold several strategic questions together under one shared purpose and outcome definition.
use_when: The selected opportunity has several interdependent strategic dimensions.
A shared purpose can legitimately constrain each quadrant.
Metrics and phases have a credible evidence/status boundary.
do_not_use_when: A four-quadrant framework is used to hide a linear dependency sequence.
The central purpose is generic and does not change choices.
The visual suggests a universal transformation timeline.
recombination.topic_selection_boundary: This record does not choose a future strategy, AI use case, timeline, metric, or procurement scope.
recombination.reverse_build_specification: When a selected opportunity needs a team to align several strategic choices, use a limited set of distinct decision zones connected by an original central purpose object. Let the visual own the coherence; use the caption to state evidence, assumptions, and facilitation context. Do not borrow the source's quadrant names, plan, metrics, central target, palette, or wording.
recombination.falsification_question: Can a team name which current decision belongs in each zone and explain how the central purpose changes it, rather than merely admiring a four-box template?

inspection_limitations: All transformation, value, use-case, metric, and maturity claims visible in the asset require separate provenance before use as factual guidance.
